responsibility: This header defines the `exynosm1_tunings` model for Samsung Exynos M1 in the AArch64 backend. It supplies Exynos-M1-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, approximation policy, prefetch settings, issue rate, and alignment/tuning parameters, providing the backend with a distinct microarchitectural cost profile for instruction selection and vector profitability decisions on this core.
